problems.text: `kmctl verify` has no way to name every page in a folder, so verifying a section of the bundle takes one id per page or a shell pipeline.
`kmctl verify` refuses the `.okf/`-prefixed paths a shell glob from the repository root gives.
`kmctl verify` accepts ids `kmctl review due` never lists, such as `decisions/index`, and writes into that file.
A refused id gets a message that names neither the folder form nor the path form.

goals.text: A person who has read a section verifies it in one short command, typed or globbed.
`kmctl verify` and `kmctl review due` agree on which files are pages.

outcomes.change: A folder id verifies every page under it that review due tracks
outcomes.checked_by: tests in `packages/kmctl/tests/test_verify.py` that verify `decisions` and a docs folder in a temporary repository and check each page's entry and the untouched index

outcomes.change: A repository-root path with .md reads as its id
outcomes.checked_by: a parametrized test in `packages/kmctl/tests/test_verify.py` passing a concept path under .okf with .md and a docs path with .md

outcomes.change: An id for a file review due never lists is refused
outcomes.checked_by: a parametrized test in `packages/kmctl/tests/test_verify.py` refusing decisions/index, the same as a .okf path with .md, log and handoffs, each writing nothing

outcomes.change: Refusals name the folder form and the help shows it
outcomes.checked_by: tests asserting the refusal text for `decisions/*` and `decisions/index`, and `packages/kmctl/tests/test_help.py` for the verb's help

outcomes.change: A draft decision record states the folder form and ADR 0055 points at it
outcomes.checked_by: `kmctl check` and strict OKF validation of `.okf/`
